items.title: Caterpillar (CAT) Is Teaming Up With WM To Test Autonomous Landfill Compactors
items.summary: WM and Caterpillar have agreed to collaborate on developing and testing autonomous landfill compactors for waste management operations. The partnership focuses on using autonomous heavy equipment to support safety and operational efficiency at landfill sites. The work centers on Caterpillar landfill compactors that can operate with reduced on site human intervention under controlled conditions.
